manifest.name: dsh-gitee-chat
manifest.description: 会话内 Gitee 项目管理：模型用触发型工具取数，脚本负责拉取，看板与图表由客户端插件在对话流里渲染并可直接操作。不做侧边栏、不维护本地数据库。
manifest.author: jackxiao <xd20260413@outlook.com> (保定多普康智能科技有限公司)

scripts.check: node scripts/check-types.mjs --check && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/render-check.mjs && node scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs --check && node scripts/check-presets.mjs --check && node scripts/build-mcp.mjs --check

bundle.text:
# dsh-gitee-chat 挂载补丁 —— **只挂 host 半**，而且**必须是纯 insert**。
#
# ⚠️ 平面纪律（本插件最容易搞错的地方）：
#   本文件挂在 profile 里，注册的东西对**所有 preset 生效**。
#   因此这里**只允许**放 host 半（执行器 + 路由 + giteeChat 服务），
#   绝不放工具、人格注入或门禁——那些属于 agent 平面，走 `dsh-gitee-chat/agent`，
#   只在 Gitee 模式（preset）里挂。
#
#   曾经把工具与人格注入写在这里，结果 PTC 等无关 preset 的新会话
#   也被注入了 Gitee 人格、也能看到 Gitee 工具。
#
# ⚠️ 为什么这里**只有 id + name**（纯 insert，一行 config 都不许有）：
#   插件市场（dshmarket）的「热挂载」只认纯 insert 形状，而它读的正是本文件
#   （`hot.js` 的 `parseSimplePatch`：市场目前只认字符串形式的 dsh.bundle.patch，
#   本包的数组形式会被它忽略 → 回落到读本文件）。
#   一旦这里出现 `config:` 行，市场「关闭后再打开」就会失败并留下**半状态**：
#   包仍在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里、而 profile 补丁被写上
#   `- id: gitee-chat` + `disabled: true`，于是 Gitee preset 还在列表里、
#   但 `giteeChat` 服务不存在 → `dsh-gitee-chat/agent` 永远 pending →
#   预设红标「加载失败」。拆成【本文件纯 insert + 配置走 profile 补丁】
#   之后，市场的热挂载能成功，这条路就断了（见 DESIGN.md §35）。
#   同理：skill 行因为**必须带 config** 而单独放在 `cordis.skills.patch.yml`。
#
# 配置从哪来（不写在这里，是因为它与默认值逐项相同，写在这里会破坏纯 insert）：
#   1. 默认值 = `src/index.ts` 的 `resolveConfig()`：apiBase、cacheTtlSeconds 0、
#      scriptTimeoutMs 60000、allowFixtureFallback false、enterpriseId 0、
#      roleTtlSeconds 600、mode auto、userAgent ''、allowWrites true、presetIds []、
#      agentRowName 'dsh-gitee-chat/agent'、docs.mcpToolPrefix 'mcp__gitee_ent__'、
#      docs.autoCheckOnRead true、docs.maxPageBytes 200000、thresholds {}。
#   2. `node scripts/setup.mjs apply` 会把**完整配置**写进 profile 的
#      `cordis.patch.yml`（哨兵段，带行内注释、且不含 token）。
#      补丁在所有 bundle 之后应用，同一 id 的 config 是**整体替换**而不是深合并。
#   3. 环境变量（GITEE_ENT_ID、GITEE_CHAT_* 等）与
#      `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/config.json` 仍按次覆盖。
#
# 用法：
#   1. 作为 bundle 安装：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "file:<本目录>"
#      （桌面版用应用自带的 dsh 命令，profile 固定 desktop；dsh web 默认 web）。
#      必须是 `file:` 而不是裸路径：裸路径会被记成 `link:`，模块 realpath 落在
#      profiles/** 之外，agent 半的裸导入解析不到（见 DESIGN.md §23）。
#   2. 手工挂载：把下面 insert 段合并进 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml
#
# agent 半（在 preset 的组合里）：
#   - id: gitee-chat-agent
#     name: 'dsh-gitee-chat/agent'
#     config:
#       injectPersona: true
#       enforceTier: true
#
# 数据口径：
#   - 不做本地数据库；数据以会话拉取为准。
#   - 模型只拿到 gq 脚本产出的 `summary` 摘要（几十~一千 token）；
#     看板卡片经 /api/gitee-chat/payload 直接取全量结构化数据，不经过模型。
#
# token：按次解析（环境变量 GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN →
#        $DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token → ~/.gitee-token）。**不回落到 preset 行**：
#        MCP server 行的 token 是另一处 !!js 表达式，见 presets/*.patch.yml。
#
# ⚠️ 这里面**没有**任何"本机 / 本公司"的东西：企业 id、API base、UA、阈值、
#    token 位置全部可从配置或环境变量覆盖。换同事 / 换机器请看 README 的
#    「换一台机器 / 换一个同事」一节，并先跑
#    `node scripts/check-presets.mjs --doctor`。

- insert:
    - id: gitee-chat
      name: 'dsh-gitee-chat'

# dsh-gitee-chat 的 skill 挂载补丁 —— 单独一个文件，而且**必须是纯 insert**。
#
# 为什么这一行不放在 `cordis.patch.yml`（两个原因，缺一不可）：
#   1. 这一行**必须带 config**（`providerName` 不能省，见下），
#      而 `cordis.patch.yml` 必须保持纯 insert —— 市场未识别
#      `dsh.bundle.patch` 数组时只读那个文件，`parseSimplePatch` 见到
#      `config:` 就返回 null，于是「关闭后再打开」永久失败并留下半状态
#      （详见 `cordis.patch.yml` 头部与 DESIGN.md §35）。
#   2. 拆开后，两个文件各自只有一个顶层 `- insert:`，谁也不覆盖谁的行；
#      市场识别数组之后（它按文件逐个判归属），本包任何一行都不算
#      "外来行"，于是关闭插件时整包从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 干净移出。
#
# skill 真源就在本包里：`<包>/skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`。
# 它教 AI 怎么**问使用者、写配置、自检** —— 也就是让安装与调参
# 完全不需要使用者打开任何文件。
#
# 四个实测出来的要点（改动前先读 DESIGN.md §17）：
#
#  1. `!!js` 里的 `baseUrl` 是 **profile 目录**（不是本包目录）。
#     所以这里按**包名** `dsh-gitee-chat` 解析 —— bundle 就装在 profile 里，
#     换机器/换 profile 都不用改这行。
#  2. **必须换 `providerName`**：dsh-base 已经挂了一个名为 `filesystem` 的
#     provider，同名会以 "a skill provider named ... is already registered"
#     让整棵插件树启动失败。⇒ 这一行**不能**简化成 id + name 两行。
#  3. **解析失败必须 fail-soft**：手工拷 lib/ 而没注册 bundle 时 resolve() 会抛，
#     那会让整个 DSH 起不来。所以包一层 try/catch，回落到一个不可能存在的路径。
#  4. 表达式必须返回**单个字符串**。`customSkillDirs` 本身已是数组，元素再返回
#     数组就会变成 `[[path]]`，报 "expected string but got [path]"。
#
# `includeDefaultRoots: false`：project / user 根已由宿主的 filesystem provider
# 覆盖，这里只贡献本包自己的 skills/，不去重复扫一遍。

- insert:
    - id: gitee-chat-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        providerName: 'gitee-chat-skills'
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        customSkillDirs:
          - !!js "(() => { const P = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const U = process.getBuiltinModule('node:url'); try { const M = process.getBuiltinModule('node:module'); const anchor = U.fileURLToPath(new URL('package.json', baseUrl)); return P.join(P.dirname(M.createRequire(anchor).resolve('dsh-gitee-chat/package.json')), 'skills') } catch { return P.join(U.fileURLToPath(baseUrl), '.dsh-gitee-chat-no-skills') } })()"

# Gitee 项目管理 preset —— 由本包的 bundle patch 交付（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch`）。
# 0.5.4 起「执行 / 管理」两个模式合并成这一个（见 docs/decisions/0002-single-preset.md）：
# 工具全量暴露，能不能写由云端 token 的角色与 PR 的 auths 决定。
#
# 为什么不再是一个目录：DSH 0.1.7 起移除了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets`（复数，
# 扫 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/` 的那个包），preset 改成**声明式**的
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`（单数）行 —— 随发行版交付的 standard/ptc/minimal/cordis
# 四个 preset 就是这么发的（`dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`）。本包照同一套做法：
# **仓库里的这份 patch 就是运行时生效的那份**，不再往用户根拷贝文件。
#
# 下面 `plugins:` 的内容与旧 `gitee-manager/agent.cordis.yml` 基本相同，只是缩进进了一层；
# 0.5.4 改了 id/name/description/persona 与工具集（全量 55 个）。
- insert:
    - id: preset-gitee
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: gitee
        name: 'Gitee 项目管理'
        description: '一个入口管 Gitee 企业项目：组合健康度与风险、工作项推进、仓库与文档、合并请求（审查/测试/合并）。工具全量可用，能读到/写到什么由云端 token 的角色决定；人格与注入上下文按身份关系自动推导。'
        order: 6
        plugins:
          # The `standard` agent preset: the full coding agent, mounted once per process.
          #
          # This file is an AGENT-PLANE composition. The roster mounts it ONCE under a
          # standing scope; every session naming it joins by scope parentage, so the
          # tools and prompt sections registered here cover each joined agent while a
          # session's own state stays keyed per Session/Agent inside the plugins. The
          # host composition (`base.cordis.yml` + `web.cordis.yml`) keeps everything a
          # preset must not own: the registries themselves, the sandbox and approval
          # stack, persistence, and the model route.
          #
          # A service row here MUST sit inside a group carrying an `isolate` realm.
          # Without one it publishes into the root realm, where it is process-global —
          # another preset publishing the same name collides, and a host reader would
          # resolve one preset's instance for every session; `dsh-agent-presets` rejects
          # that at mount. `true` means an entry-local realm: this standing mount's own
          # private instance, apart from every other preset's. (A shared label does NOT
          # pool instances — `provide()` throws on the second registration under the
          # same realm symbol; labels join REALMS, and are not what this file needs.)

          # ── identity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The preset's own persona, shadowing the deployment default for this agent.
          # A template here may only use the prompt variables the host actually registers
          # (`{{provider}}`, `{{model}}`); an unknown one is not ignored — the prompt render
          # fails and the whole turn dies with `unknown prompt variable "…"`. `{{cwd}}` used
          # to be available and no longer is, so the workspace path comes from the injected
          # runtime context instead of a persona suffix.
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              suffix: 工作区路径与运行时信息由注入的运行时上下文给出，按其中的目录执行命令，不要假设路径。
              prefix: >-
                你是 Gitee 项目管理助手。看组合健康度与风险，也直接推动落地：工作项该推进就推进、该上报阻塞就上报，文档该建就建，合并请求按审查/测试结论走。

                权限不由你或用户手选：能读到什么、能不能写，全部由云端 token 的角色决定。界面上按钮可不可点，以 `get_enterprise_pull_auth` 这类真实权限返回为准，不要按「模式」推断。

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536

          # ── shell ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # `shell-env` stays in the HOST composition: `apps/cli/src/web.ts` injects it to
          # publish `DSH_WEB_URL`/`DSH_WEB_MODE`, and a host row that injects a service is
          # the criterion for host-plane ownership — injection resolves before any session
          # exists, so there is no agent to key by. Behind a preset realm those variables
          # never reached the model's shell at all. Both shell tools consume the host
          # registry from here; their executors (`bash-sandbox`/`pwsh-sandbox`) are
          # host-plane too.
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'

          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'

          # ── filesystem ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Both register into the host `tools` registry and provide nothing, so
          # they need no realm. The `fs` service and its policy stay in the host.
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

          # ── background jobs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Only the model-facing controls. The task REGISTRY stays on the host plane:
          # its producers sit outside any realm this file could put it in — `tool-bash`
          # above resolves it with `ctx.get`, and an entry-local realm here is invisible
          # to every sibling row, so `run_in_background` would answer "background jobs
          # unavailable" while these controls sat in the catalog. The registry is keyed by
          # owning agent anyway, so one host instance serves every session. What a preset
          # chooses is whether its agent can collect and stop background work at all.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

          # ── skills ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The skill REGISTRY lives in the host composition and is layered per scope:
          # these rows register into THIS preset's layer of it, so they need no realm.
          # `skill-filesystem` contributes local-root discovery for agents on this preset, and
          # `tool-skill` gives them the catalog and loader; the merged catalog also
          # carries whatever the deployment registered globally (repository plugins).
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'

          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # ── goals ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The goal service and session driver stay on the host plane, where the Gateway
          # can resolve them. The human command and model-facing tool register into this
          # preset's scoped layers.
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'

          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

          # ── plan mode ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # Plan state is per-agent by nature, so an entry-local realm is not a
          # workaround here — it is the correct lifetime.
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                        You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                        Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                        The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                        Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                        Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                        When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

          # ── compaction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # `compaction-basic` reads `toolResultPrune` through `ctx.get`, so the pruner must
          # share this realm rather than sit outside it.
          #
          # `tokenMeter` is deliberately NOT in this realm: the meter stays on the HOST
          # plane, and the rows here resolve that one instance. It takes no configuration,
          # keys every fold by Session, and owns the context-meter projection units the
          # browser reads for every session — behind a realm those units would come and go
          # with whichever presets happen to be mounted. What a preset chooses is whether
          # its agent compacts at all, which is `compaction-basic` below.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

          # ── delegation and workflows ────────────────────────────────────────────────

          # The `subagents` registry and its spawn/fork backends live in the HOST
          # composition: the registry is a process singleton whose cross-session queries
          # the api-proxy serves to the browser, and a provider name may only be
          # registered once. This preset contributes the delegation TOOLS, which resolve
          # that host registry.
          #
          # `workflows` is different — nothing outside an agent reads it — so every row
          # that reaches it shares one entry-local realm here, and a consumer left
          # outside would resolve a host registry this preset does not populate.
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

              # DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 folded `list_agents` into `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control`
              # (that version exports only ".", so the old `…/list-agents` subpath no longer
              # imports). A row whose import fails has no fiber, and the registry reports the
              # WHOLE preset as broken — the preset then silently disappears from the
              # new-session picker. Hence only the package root here: rc.3 provides the tool
              # from it, and on an older runtime the row simply contributes nothing.

              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              # Fork omits model selection so provider/model stay equal to the parent and
              # the inherited history remains eligible for KV Cache reuse. This preset
              # keeps fork continuable; parent and child inherit the same messaging tool,
              # while the parent id and return guidance follow the inherited history.
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable

              # Production dsh does not install these optional providers. Install the
              # matching Bundle in this Profile and restart the Host, then copy this
              # preset and remove `disabled` from the matching tool row. Host availability
              # alone grants no tool.
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed

              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed

              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn

              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'

              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64

          # ── remaining model-facing rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────

          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true

          # The `web` service and its search provider stay in the host composition; only
          # the model-facing tool is per-session.
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000

          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'

          # ── Gitee 项目管理（仅本 preset）────────────────────────────────────────
          #
          # 顺序说明：mcp-gitee 注册 MCP 工具；gitee-chat-agent 注册触发型工具、
          # 人格注入与能力档门禁。两者都**只在本 preset 生效**——
          # host 半（路由 + giteeChat 服务）已由 profile bundle 提供。

          - id: mcp-gitee
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
            config:
              serverName: gitee_ent
              transport: stdio
              # 随包 MCP 后端：优先用插件落地的那份（见下），无需 Go 环境。
              #
              # 三级回落（顺序即优先级）：
              #   1. MCP_GITEE_ENT_BIN —— 显式指定，给"我有自己的二进制"的同事；
              #   2. 用户级 bin（0.5.1 起）—— POSIX `$XDG_BIN_HOME` → `~/.local/bin`，
              #      Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`：插件启动时把包内
              #      vendor/mcp-gitee-ent/ 的二进制落到那里（公开 MCP 的标准位置，
              #      不再塞进插件私有的 $DSH_HOME）；0.5.0 的旧副本若还在也认（过渡）；
              #   3. PATH 上的 mcp-gitee-ent —— 自己 go install 过的同事照旧能用。
              #
              # ⚠️ 这条表达式只能用 `process`：!!js 的求值上下文里没有 require，
              #    所以内置模块走 process.getBuiltinModule（Node 22.3+）。
              # ⚠️ 必须整句用双引号包住（`!!js "…"`）：表达式里含 `: ` 序列，
              #    写成 plain 标量会被 YAML 在读到时截断。
              # ⚠️ 落地路径的三处实现必须一致：本行、src/host/mcpBinary.ts 的
              #    materializedPath()、scripts/setup.mjs 的 mcpTargetPath()。
              command: !!js "process.env.MCP_GITEE_ENT_BIN || (() => { const F = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const P = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const OS = process.getBuiltinModule('node:os'); const win = process.platform === 'win32'; const name = 'mcp-gitee-ent' + (win ? '.exe' : ''); const home = OS.homedir(); const xdg = process.env.XDG_BIN_HOME; const dir = win ? P.join(home, '.local', 'bin') : ((xdg && xdg.trim()) || P.join(home, '.local', 'bin')); const exe = P.join(dir, name); if (F.existsSync(exe)) return exe; const legacy = P.join(process.env.DSH_HOME || P.join(home, '.dsh'), '.gitee-chat', 'bin', name); return F.existsSync(legacy) ? legacy : 'mcp-gitee-ent' })()"
              # 工具集全量下发（55 个）：0.5.4 起不再按能力档裁剪 —— 越档调用由公开
              # gateway 的 tools.guard 硬拦（不只是提示词里写着）。名单由 gq.mjs 的 TIERS 生成，勿手改。
              args:
                - '--enabled-toolsets'
                - 'list_enterprises,get_user_info,list_programs,list_doc_nodes,list_program_doc_nodes,download_attach_file,list_enterprise_documents,list_enterprise_document_pages,get_enterprise_document_page,download_enterprise_document,list_enterprise_issues,get_enterprise_issue_detail,list_enterprise_issue_comments,list_issue_types,list_issue_type_states,list_enterprise_labels,list_enterprise_repositories,get_enterprise_repo_tree,get_enterprise_repository_file_content,list_enterprise_repo_releases,list_enterprise_pulls,get_enterprise_pull_detail,get_enterprise_pull_diff,list_enterprise_pull_comments,get_enterprise_pull_auth,list_enterprise_pull_files,list_enterprise_members,list_enterprise_groups,list_scrum_sprints,list_scrum_versions,create_enterprise_issue,update_enterprise_issue,comment_enterprise_issue,create_enterprise_repo_pull,comment_enterprise_pull,update_enterprise_pull,review_enterprise_pull,test_enterprise_pull,create_doc_node,attach_doc_file,create_enterprise_document,create_enterprise_document_node,update_enterprise_document_page,upload_enterprise_document_files,create_scrum_sprint,create_wiki,move_doc_node,rename_enterprise_document_folder,create_program,create_enterprise_repository,merge_enterprise_pull,create_enterprise_repo_release,set_doc_node_auth,recycle_doc_node,delete_doc_node'
              env:
                # 必须显式传：dsh-mcp-client 会清洗子进程环境，
                # 删掉匹配 /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i 的变量（GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN 正中）。
                #
                # 三个变量名依次回落，谁先有值用谁——不同同事习惯的名字不一样，
                # 不必为了装这个插件改自己的环境。
                #
                # ⚠️ 再回落读「设置界面里填的那份 token 文件」（顺序与 gq.mjs 一致）：
                #    $DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token → $DSH_HOME/gitee-chat-token → ~/.gitee-token。
                #    桌面版 DSH 从开始菜单启动时**不继承** shell 里 export 的变量，
                #    只认设置界面写下的文件。少了这一段，在没设环境变量的机器上本表达式
                #    会求值成 undefined，而 dsh-mcp-client 的 env 校验（z.dict(String)）
                #    拒绝 undefined ⇒ 整行 mount 失败 ⇒ 两个 Gitee preset 永久「加载失败」
                #    且不会自愈（挂载失败是终态）。**本表达式必须始终返回字符串**。
                # ⚠️ 与 command 一样必须整句用双引号包住（表达式里含 `: ` 与 `=>`，
                #    写成 plain 标量会被 YAML 截断）。
                GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN: !!js "(() => { const E = process.env; const fromEnv = [E.GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN, E.GITEE_ACCESS_TOKEN, E.GITEE_TOKEN].find((v) => typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== ''); if (fromEnv !== undefined) return fromEnv.trim(); try { const F = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const P = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const O = process.getBuiltinModule('node:os'); const dshHome = E.DSH_HOME || P.join(O.homedir(), '.dsh'); const files = [P.join(dshHome, '.gitee-chat', 'token'), P.join(dshHome, 'gitee-chat-token'), P.join(O.homedir(), '.gitee-token')]; for (const f of files) { try { const t = F.readFileSync(f, 'utf8').trim(); if (t !== '') return t; } catch (e) {} } } catch (e) {} return ''; })()"
                # 多企业时必须显式指定（插件不会替你猜）；单企业留空即可。
                #
                # ⚠️ 同样回落读 config.json 的 enterpriseId：gq 脚本的解析顺序是
                #    flag > 环境变量 > 配置文件 > 自动（多企业时报错，绝不静默挑一个）。
                #    `gq enterprises --use <id>` 与设置界面写的都是这份文件，跟着读
                #    才能让 MCP 通道与插件取数通道落到同一个企业。
                GITEE_ENT_ID: !!js "(() => { const E = process.env; const id = Number(E.GITEE_ENT_ID || E.GITEE_CHAT_ENTERPRISE_ID || 0); if (Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0) return String(id); try { const F = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const P = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path'); const O = process.getBuiltinModule('node:os'); const dshHome = E.DSH_HOME || P.join(O.homedir(), '.dsh'); const cfg = JSON.parse(F.readFileSync(P.join(dshHome, '.gitee-chat', 'config.json'), 'utf8')); const fromFile = Number(cfg && cfg.enterpriseId); if (Number.isFinite(fromFile) && fromFile > 0) return String(fromFile); } catch (e) {} return ''; })()"

          - id: gitee-chat-agent
            name: 'dsh-gitee-chat/agent'
            config:
              injectPersona: true
              enforceTier: true

readme.text:
把 **Gitee 项目管理**装进 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 会话：
一整页能点的项目工作台 + 一套能写的工具 + 随包的 55 个 Gitee 企业 MCP 工具。

- **面板不占上下文**：工作项/合并请求/知识库的数据由面板自己向宿主取，多大的数据量都不进模型；
- **工具只回摘要**：`gitee_board` 给模型的是几十到一千 token 的摘要，卡片直接向宿主路由要全量数据；
- **写操作有边界**：界面只做最小写集合（状态 / 指派 / 评论 / 新建工作项 / PR 动作），其余交给 MCP。

会话头里的「Gitee 项目」是一个**整页工作台**（渲染在会话正文区，不接管也不顶掉右侧边栏），
六个页签：

| 页签 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 概览 | 企业级 KPI、风险提醒、最近动态 |
| 项目 | 左侧项目列表 + 仓库卡片 + 工作项表（未完成 / 已完成 / 逾期 / 全部）；点行开详情，点仓库卡片下钻三栏（项目 / 仓库 / 仓库资源） |
| 我的工作项 | 负责人 + 协作者两种关系的聚合，带未完成 / 完成 / 逾期筛选 |
| 合并请求 | 待我审核 / 待我测试 / 我提出的 / 全部 + 状态筛选；点行开抽屉 |
| 知识库 | 左侧项目 + 节点树 + 可拖分栏；节点按需展开，附件按需下载，预览优先交给侧边栏 |
| 固定分析 | 9 张卡片：项目健康度 / 成员负载 / 延期清单 / 停滞 / 规范体检 / 进度偏差 / 交付容量 / 里程碑达成 / 交付趋势 |

**仓库卡片下钻**：项目详情里的仓库卡片点进去是三栏（项目列表 | 仓库列表 | 仓库资源），
左栏可拖宽并记住；默认「本项目」、可切「内源仓库」，口径跨项目保留；仓库详情三个页签（工作项 / 合并请求 / WIKI）
用暖浅色区分。工作项可点开详情，右上角能直接新建（挂在这个仓库下）。

**合并请求全流程**（抽屉里）：概览 · 变更文件 · 评论 · AI 审核 → 审核通过 / 驳回 → 测试通过 →
合并；「＋ 新建 PR」支持手动填表（仓库 / 分支 / 标题 / 描述 / 审查人数 / 测试人数 / 草稿 / 套用模板），
走宿主 `POST /pr/create`，与 MCP 的 `create_enterprise_repo_pull` 等价。

**AI 审核**：把审核任务投递到**所选主会话下的子智能体**（不往主会话插用户消息），面板轮询结论并给出
可一键落地的操作（提交评论并驳回 / 通过）。审核与测试模板分开绑定、面板内可编辑（存为用户副本）；
PR 描述模板在新建 PR 时一键套用。失败原因按白话映射（not-reviewer / nothing-to-reset / nothing-to-merge）。

**工作项**：新建（标题 / 负责人 / 优先级 / 计划时间必填，弹窗照 Gitee 网页版）、改状态、改派、评论；
状态用四色药丸区分。写操作后不整页重拉：后台重取数据后原地更新。详情页含描述、
前置依赖（认 Gitee 编号与 WBS 编码两种写法）与评论讨论。

**能力档**：只有一个 agent 预设「Gitee 项目管理」。档位不是选出来的，而是每次取数按 **token 在
Gitee 云端的角色与项目关系**推导：企业拥有者/超管/管理员 = 管理者（55 个 MCP 工具，跨项目分析）；
某项目负责人 = 负责人档（48）；其他 = 执行档（40，只看本人工作项）。换企业 / 换 token 即时改档。

要求：DSH `^0.2.0-rc.2`，Node `^22.19 || >=24`。

readme.section: 从 npm 官方源装（推荐）
readme.text:
- **profile 要对**：装错是静默失效 —— 界面里什么都没有，也不报错。
- 桌面版用**应用自带**的 `dsh`（`<应用目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`），全局装的那个会拒绝 `--profile desktop`。
- **升级 = `remove` 再 `add`**（装进去的是副本，没有自动更新）。从 0.5.3 升上来时，profile 里可能还留着
  旧的预设行（`preset-gitee-exec` / `preset-gitee-manager`），记得一并删掉，避免出现两个 Gitee 入口。
- npm 只往官方源（`registry.npmjs.org`）发；国内镜像会自动同步，不要往镜像发。
- 装完在 **设置 → Gitee 企业项目** 填企业版 access token。
- 脚本层面只随发运行期脚本（`scripts/setup.mjs`、`scripts/check-presets.mjs`、`scripts/gitee/`），
  构建与自检脚本留在仓库（`npm run check` 用）；npm 包发 `lib/`（含 `lib/types/`），不再发 `src`。
- 让 AI 全程代办：本包自带 `skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`，说一句「装这个 Gitee 插件，配置项问我」即可。

「设置 → Gitee 企业项目」一页管完，**保存即生效，不用重启**：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 企业版 Token | 存到 `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token`；取数脚本与 MCP 子进程读同一份 |
| 当前企业 | token 可见多个企业时选一个，避免「拿错公司数据」 |
| 会话里的 AI 可以读看板快照 | 默认开：`gitee_board_snapshot` 返回快照（带时效），不必翻页重拉 |
| 快照落盘 | 默认开：缓存写到 `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/cache/`，重启后仍可命中 |
| 新鲜期（秒） | 默认 60，最小 10，`0` = 关闭缓存 |
| 后台定期刷新 | 默认关；开着时按下面的间隔预取看板，让人打开面板就是热的 |
| 刷新间隔（秒） | 默认 60，最小 10 |
| 闲置暂停（分钟） | 默认 30：这段时间内没人用面板就不刷，避免空转与限流 |

缓存的本地覆盖写在 `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/config.json`，优先级高于插件补丁里的静态配置。

token 解析顺序：环境变量 `GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN` / `GITEE_ACCESS_TOKEN` / `GITEE_TOKEN` →
`$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token` → `$DSH_HOME/gitee-chat-token` → `~/.gitee-token`。
桌面版从开始菜单启动时**不继承 shell 的 export**，所以优先在设置页里填。

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `gitee_board` | 看板摘要（模型看摘要，面板看全量） |
| `gitee_board_snapshot` | 直接读缓存快照，返回 `fetchedAt / ageSeconds / stale / ttlSeconds` |
| `gitee_role` | 当前 token 的身份、人格与能力档 |
| `gitee_enterprises` | 列出 / 切换当前企业 |
| `gitee_chat_health` | 取数环境自检（token / 企业 / 连通性） |
| `gitee_ent` | **公共 gateway**：`op:"list"` → `op:"schema"` → `op:"call"`，在非 Gitee 预设会话里可调 55 个企业 MCP 工具 |

Gitee 预设会话里 `gitee_ent` 刻意隐藏（避免绕过档位门禁），改用原生 `mcp__gitee_ent__*`（按档裁剪）。
只读部署（`allowWrites: false`）下写工具会被硬拦；真正的权限边界始终在 Gitee 云端 token 的角色。

`vendor/mcp-gitee-ent/` 随包分发 `mcp-gitee-ent` 二进制（Linux / Windows amd64，上游基线 **v0.2.5**，
55 个工具）。安装时自动落地到用户级 bin（Linux/macOS `~/.local/bin`，Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`），
不需要 `go install`；其他平台用 `MCP_GITEE_ENT_BIN` 指到自己的二进制。MCP 是进程级直连，
**没有会话模式门槛**：任何会话都能取数，能不能写仍看云端 token。PR 子资源参数统一为
`pull_request_iid`（0.5.3 及以前是 `pull_request_id`）；fork 侧 4 个自有 PR 工具
（accept / reject / reset / test）同步改名；附件下载遇到 404 会自动兜底。

- 单次取数是「起一个 Node 脚本 → HTTPS 打 Gitee 企业 API」，单轮 RTT 约 0.4s；
- 读路由带 30s 缓存，执行器结果再记 60s，并做并发单飞（同一请求同时只发一次）；写完两层都清，重复点击 <10ms；
- 工作项列表悬停即预取详情，点下去直接命中缓存；
- 看板翻页改并发探测：307 条工作项 2.6s → 1.6s；工作项详情 1.8s → 0.5s（详情与评论并发、无依赖就不拉索引）；
- 面板打开时先渲染上次的快照再后台刷新（默认 60s 内算新鲜），会话也能用 `gitee_board_snapshot` 直读同一份；
- 慢请求记一条 `[gitee-chat][slow]` 日志，`GITEE_CHAT_TRACE=1` 全量打印。

```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build        # lib/*.js + lib/types/（宿主 / agent / 面板）
npm run check        # 类型 + 冒烟 + 渲染断言 + 能力矩阵 + preset 交付 + MCP 二进制校验
npm run doctor       # 可移植性体检（preset / 插件行 / 产物 / token / 企业）

`src/index.ts` 是宿主半（路由、缓存、写出口、设置），`src/agent.ts` 是 agent 半（工具与人格），
`src/client/` 是面板组件（`GiteeProjectView.tsx` 为整页入口），`scripts/gitee/gq.mjs` 是取数脚本。

| 文档 | 给谁看 |
|---|---|
| [`USAGE.md`](./USAGE.md) | 使用者：界面怎么用、出问题怎么办 |
| [`skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`](./skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md) | AI：安装 / 配置 / 诊断 / MCP 用法（索引层，细节在 `references/{mcp,panel,recipes,install}.md`） |

设计说明、决策记录、功能清单、能力矩阵属于**内部开发资料**，不随仓库分发
（`node scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs` 可重建能力矩阵）。

English: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)
[MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 保定多普康智能科技有限公司 · jackxiao (xd20260413@outlook.com)

Gitee project management inside a [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) session:
a full-page, clickable project workbench + a set of write-capable tools + 55 Gitee Enterprise MCP tools
bundled in.

"Gitee 项目" in the session header is a **full-page workbench** (rendered in the conversation body, it
neither takes over nor pushes out the right sidebar), with six tabs:

| Tab | Contents |
|---|---|
| Overview | Enterprise KPIs, risk reminders, recent activity |
| Projects | Project list on the left + repo cards + work-item table (open / done / overdue / all); a row opens details, a repo card drills into three columns (project / repo / repo resources) |
| My Work Items | Items where you are assignee **or** collaborator, with open / done / overdue filters |
| Merge Requests | Awaiting my review / awaiting my test / opened by me / all, plus state filters; a row opens the drawer |
| Knowledge Base | Project list + node tree with a draggable split; nodes expand on demand, attachments download on demand, previews prefer the sidebar |
| Fixed Analysis | Nine cards: project health / member load / overdue list / stalled / conventions / schedule variance / delivery capacity / milestones / delivery trend |

**Repo card drilldown**: clicking a repo card in project details opens three columns (projects | repos |
repo resources); the left column is draggable and remembered; the scope defaults to "this project" and
can switch to internal open-source, kept across projects; repo details have three tabs (work items /
merge requests / WIKI) in warm tints. Work items open in place, and new ones can be created from the
top right (attached to that repo).

**Merge request flow** (inside the drawer): overview · changed files · comments · AI review → approve /
reject → tests pass → merge. "＋ 新建 PR" supports manual entry (repo / branches / title / description /
reviewer count / tester count / draft / template) and posts to the host route `POST /pr/create`, which
is equivalent to the MCP tool `create_enterprise_repo_pull`.

**AI review**: the review job is dispatched to a **subagent under the session you pick** (no user
message is injected into the main conversation); the panel polls the conclusion and offers one-click
follow-ups (comment + reject / approve). Review and test templates are bound separately and editable in
the panel (stored as your copy); the PR description template is applied when creating a PR. Failure
reasons are mapped to plain language (not-reviewer / nothing-to-reset / nothing-to-merge).

**Work items**: create (title / assignee / priority / schedule are required, the dialog mirrors the
Gitee web UI), change state, reassign, comment; states use four colored pills. Writes do not reload the
page: data is refetched in the background and updated in place. Details show the description,
prerequisites (both Gitee identifiers and WBS codes) and the comment thread.

**Capability tiers**: there is exactly one agent preset, "Gitee 项目管理". The tier is not selected but
derived on every fetch from **the token's role and project relationships in Gitee Cloud**: enterprise
owner / super-admin / admin = manager (55 MCP tools, cross-project analysis); a project assignee =
project tier (48); everyone else = exec tier (40, own work items only). Switching enterprise or token
changes the tier immediately.

Requires DSH `^0.2.0-rc.2`, Node `^22.19 || >=24`.

readme.section: install from the official npm registry (recommended)
readme.text:
- **Get the profile right**: a wrong profile fails silently — nothing shows up and no error is reported.
- On desktop use the **bundled** `dsh` (`<app dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`); a globally installed one rejects `--profile desktop`.
- **Upgrade = `remove` then `add`** (the installed copy never auto-updates). Coming from 0.5.3, the profile may
  still hold the old preset rows (`preset-gitee-exec` / `preset-gitee-manager`) — delete them to avoid two Gitee entries.
- npm publishes only to the official registry (`registry.npmjs.org`); mirrors sync automatically, never publish to a mirror.
- After installing, fill the enterprise access token in **Settings → Gitee 企业项目**.
- Only runtime scripts ship (`scripts/setup.mjs`, `scripts/check-presets.mjs`, `scripts/gitee/`); build and
  self-check scripts stay in the repo (used by `npm run check`); the npm package ships `lib/` (including
  `lib/types/`) and no longer ships `src`.
- Let an AI do it end to end: this package bundles `skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`, so "install this Gitee plugin, ask me for config" is enough.
"Settings → Gitee 企业项目" covers everything and **takes effect immediately, no restart**:

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Enterprise token | Stored in `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token`; the fetch script and the MCP child process read the same file |
| Current enterprise | Pick one when the token sees several, to avoid "wrong company's data" |
| Session AI may read the board snapshot | On by default: `gitee_board_snapshot` returns a snapshot (with freshness) instead of refetching pages |
| Persist snapshots | On by default: cache is written to `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/cache/` and survives restarts |
| Freshness (seconds) | Default 60, minimum 10, `0` disables caching |
| Background refresh | Off by default; when on, the board is prefetched at the interval below so opening the panel is warm |
| Refresh interval (seconds) | Default 60, minimum 10 |
| Idle pause (minutes) | Default 30: no refresh while nobody uses the panel, avoiding idle load and rate limits |

Local overrides live in `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/config.json` and take precedence over the static config in
the plugin patch.

Token resolution order: env `GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN` / `GITEE_ACCESS_TOKEN` / `GITEE_TOKEN` →
`$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token` → `$DSH_HOME/gitee-chat-token` → `~/.gitee-token`.
The desktop app started from the menu **does not inherit shell exports**, so prefer the settings page.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `gitee_board` | Board summary (the model sees the summary, the panel sees the full payload) |
| `gitee_board_snapshot` | Reads the cached snapshot directly, returning `fetchedAt / ageSeconds / stale / ttlSeconds` |
| `gitee_role` | Identity, persona and capability tier of the current token |
| `gitee_enterprises` | List / switch the current enterprise |
| `gitee_chat_health` | Fetch-environment self-check (token / enterprise / connectivity) |
| `gitee_ent` | **Public gateway**: `op:"list"` → `op:"schema"` → `op:"call"`, exposing the 55 enterprise MCP tools outside the Gitee preset |

Inside the Gitee preset session `gitee_ent` is deliberately hidden (to prevent bypassing tier gating);
use the native `mcp__gitee_ent__*` tools (trimmed per tier) instead. In a read-only deployment
(`allowWrites: false`) write tools are blocked outright; the real boundary is always the token's role in
Gitee Cloud.

`vendor/mcp-gitee-ent/` ships the `mcp-gitee-ent` binary (Linux / Windows amd64, upstream baseline
**v0.2.5**, 55 tools). It is installed into a user-level bin on setup (Linux/macOS `~/.local/bin`,
Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`), so `go install` is not needed; on other platforms point
`MCP_GITEE_ENT_BIN` at your own binary. MCP is a process-level direct connection with **no session-mode
gate**: any session can fetch data, and writes still depend on the cloud token. PR sub-resource parameters
are uniformly `pull_request_iid` (0.5.3 and earlier used `pull_request_id`); the fork's four own PR tools
(accept / reject / reset / test) were renamed accordingly; attachment downloads fall back automatically on 404.

```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build        # lib/*.js + lib/types/ (host / agent / panel)
npm run check        # types + smoke + render assertions + capability matrix + preset delivery + MCP binary check
npm run doctor       # portability check (preset / plugin rows / artifacts / token / enterprise)

`src/index.ts` is the host half (routes, caches, write endpoints, settings), `src/agent.ts` the agent half
(tools and persona), `src/client/` the panel components (`GiteeProjectView.tsx` is the full-page entry),
and `scripts/gitee/gq.mjs` the fetch script.

| Doc | Audience |
|---|---|
| [`USAGE.md`](./USAGE.md) | Users: how the UI works, what to do when something breaks |
| [`skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`](./skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md) | AI: install / configure / diagnose / MCP usage (index layer, details in `references/{mcp,panel,recipes,install}.md`) |

Design notes, decision records, the feature list and the capability matrix are **internal material** and
are not distributed with the repo (`node scripts/gen-capabilities.mjs` regenerates the capability matrix).
